rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides direct access to PLAUD AI transcription and note-taking device data through four tools: browser-based authentication that captures login tokens, file listing with pagination, transcript and summary retrieval in multiple formats (JSON, SRT, VTT, text), and audio file downloading with optional format conversion via ffmpeg. Handles regional API endpoint discovery, token persistence, and batch audio downloads with configurable concurrency. Built as a standalone JavaScript file for easy installation via Claude Code or Codex CLI.
